from scipy.optimize import least_squares
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
def fitmodel(name,f,p0,n=8):
    best=(None,np.inf)
    for s in range(n):
        q=np.array(p0,float)+ (0 if s==0 else rng.standard_normal(len(p0))*0.7)
        def res(p):
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                v=f(p)
            v=np.nan_to_num(v,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3)
            return (v-sigma)/sigma
        try:
            r=least_squares(res,q,max_nfev=2000)
            c=np.mean(r.fun**2)
            if c<best[1]: best=(np.round(r.x,4),c)
        except Exception as e:
            print('ERR',name,e); break
    print(name,best[0],best[1])
